instincts.pattern: Dice apply URLs redirect to the actual ATS
instincts.action: Navigate to Dice URL, wait for redirect, detect real platform from final URL
Proceed directly to form fill without login step

instincts.pattern: Lever forms are often single-page with all fields visible
instincts.action: Fill all fields before clicking submit, no multi-page navigation needed

instincts.pattern: Workday applications are always multi-page (5-7 pages)
instincts.action: Expect page-by-page flow with Next buttons. Resume may auto-parse.

instincts.pattern: EEO questions (gender, race, veteran, disability) are always optional
instincts.action: Select 'Decline to self-identify' or 'I don't wish to answer' for all EEO questions

instincts.pattern: LinkedIn Easy Apply has a 'Follow company' checkbox on review page
instincts.action: Uncheck the follow checkbox before submitting

instincts.pattern: Any question about requiring visa sponsorship
Any question about being authorized to work in the US
instincts.action: Answer 'Yes' — candidate is authorized on F1 OPT/STEM OPT

instincts.pattern: Any question about start date or availability
Any question about salary expectation or compensation
Need to read page content during application
instincts.action: Always use browser_snapshot (accessibility tree) not browser_take_screenshot

instincts.pattern: 'How did you hear about us' or 'referral source' question
instincts.action: Answer 'LinkedIn' or 'Dice' based on job source

instincts.pattern: Cover letter upload or textarea (not required)
instincts.action: Skip if optional. If required, generate from template in profile_data.md

instincts.pattern: A new generic question was answered via LLM
instincts.action: Add the Q&A to the flow's commonQuestions so it's free next time
